toolCalls.name: StructuredOutput

output.brief:
What is going on: the rise in cancellations is mainly a Quillbook accounting-sync problem, not the price rise. Quillbook-connected accounts roughly tripled their monthly churn (about 2% to 6%) whether they were repriced or on the Founders price lock. Repriced accounts with no accounting connector barely moved (1.8% to 1.9%), so the price rise alone does not explain the spike. Support data fits this: sync tickets more than doubled, with invoices missing or doubled at month-end, and slow replies were concentrated on accounts that cancelled. Tallymarsh changes are small and within normal noise. Seasonal variation and the March app release do not explain it either.

How sure: fairly confident on the Quillbook link, less sure of the mechanism and of how much of the churn support delays cause. I have not checked the error logs.

What to do next: fix the Quillbook sync first and contact affected Quillbook accounts to correct their invoices. Do not switch off the duplicate-invoice hold, since that would push bad invoices through. Do not roll back the price or rebuild Tallymarsh yet; neither is supported by the data. Sufficient to act now on Quillbook.
output.methodChoice: Collected 1 of 2 allowed items (X13); stopped early because it resolved the price-versus-connector question.
